    Can't do that here
    
          
      
            
    • Video to video. That needs video encoders a web page can't use. You can still save a video's sound as WAV.
      • 
            
    • Making MP3s. That needs an MP3 encoder, and browsers don't ship one. You get WAV instead: bigger, but it plays everywhere.
      • 
            
    • Reading PDFs, HEIC photos, Word or Excel files. Browsers can't open those by themselves.
      • 
          
    
        
    
      
    
    
    

    
    
    
      
    
        
    How to use it
    
        
      
          
    1. Drop or choose files, or paste some text (or try the sample).
      2. 
          
    2. Each file shows what it is. Pick what it should become.
      3. 
          
    3. Press Convert all.
      4. 
          
    4. Download each file, or all of them as one .zip.
      5. 
        
    
        
    
          
    Do thisPhoneKeyboard
    
          
            
    Add filesTap Choose filesTab to it, Enter, or Ctrl + V
    
            
    Paste textPaste in the box, tap Add to the listCtrl + V in the box, Tab, Enter
    
            
    Pick a formatTap the "to" menuTab to it, arrows
    
            
    See a previewTap the file nameTab to the name, Enter
    
            
    ConvertConvert allTab to it, Enter
    
            
    DownloadDownload, or Download all (.zip)Tab to it, Enter
